about_description: I have been stitching salwar suits and blouses from home for 8 years, and I specialize in hand embroidery and bridal wear alterations. I can take custom orders and work with delicate fabrics.
I run a small tailoring setup and do quick alterations, hemming, and simple stitching for daily wear. New to bridal work but eager to learn.
Skilled in zardozi and hand embroidery for wedding lehengas and bridal blouses. I have worked with several boutique designers on intricate bridal pieces.
I bake custom celebration cakes and cupcakes from my home kitchen, and I love designing themed cakes for birthdays and weddings.
Experienced home cook who caters small events, specializing in traditional South Indian meals and snacks. Comfortable handling bulk orders for parties.
I tutor school children in mathematics and science after my own household work. Patient with beginners and comfortable teaching up to grade 10 level.
I make handmade resin jewelry and craft decor items at home, and I am looking for small collaboration or bulk order work with local businesses.
Freelance mehendi and bridal makeup artist, available for weddings and small events. I bring my own kit and can travel locally.
I recently completed a tailoring course and am just starting out. I enjoy stitching simple kids' clothes and basic blouses and want to build more experience.
Trained fashion designer who now works independently designing and stitching custom bridal and party wear, including detailed embroidery finishing.
I handle small home-catering orders including snacks, cakes, and festive sweets, and I am comfortable planning menus for family functions.
I teach basic art and craft classes to children and also take orders for handmade greeting cards and gift wrapping.
